envelope.description: Add the shared builder of valid code review records and its test

body.title: Add the shared builder of valid code review records and its test
body.summary: Add a non-test helper file under src/workflow/__tests__/helpers that builds a code review record (verdict, counts, subject.changedFiles covering every BUILD changeLog file, subject.buildFingerprint from reviewedBuildFingerprint, and optional meta so a test can set the author and reviewer parties) for a given BUILD record. Add a separate .test.ts file that checks reviewBuildGap accepts the builder's record and still refuses each invalid variant: no verdict, no changedFiles, no buildFingerprint, a stale fingerprint, an uncovered changeLog file.
acceptanceChecks: The builder's record gives reviewBuildGap undefined for a BUILD with a two-file changeLog
Each of the five invalid variants is refused with the gate's own message
The builder file is not named .test.ts and the builder has its own test file

tests.name: review-record-builder.test.ts: the builder's record passes reviewBuildGap for a BUILD with a two-file changeLog
review-record-builder.test.ts: reviewBuildGap still refuses a review with no verdict, no changedFiles, no buildFingerprint, a stale fingerprint or an uncovered changeLog file
